import math

# Monthly increases (in millions of dollars)
july_increase = 1.3
august_increase = 1.4
september_increase = 4.0

# Calculate mean of July and August
mean = (july_increase + august_increase) / 2
print(f"Mean of July and August: {mean}")

# Calculate standard deviation of July and August
# Using population standard deviation (N, not N-1) since we're comparing against these as reference
variance = ((july_increase - mean)**2 + (august_increase - mean)**2) / 2
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Standard deviation: {std_dev}")

# Calculate z-score for September
z_score = (september_increase - mean) / std_dev
print(f"Z-score for September: {z_score}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
z_score_rounded = round(z_score, 2)
print(f"Z-score rounded: {z_score_rounded}")

# Determine if statistically unusual (z > 1.96)
is_unusual = z_score > 1.96
print(f"Is unusual (z > 1.96): {is_unusual}")

# Output format
result = f"[{z_score_rounded}, {'unusual' if is_unusual else 'normal'}]"
print(f"\nResult: {result}")
EOF
